name: Love My Job
overview:
“The First Day of Office Hell and the Crazy Competition” Namtao, an ordinary girl, enters an office where nothing is normal. From the motorcycle taxi driver to the receptionist who looks exactly like the CEO, everyone seems to come from the universe of The Face Thailand.

She must survive sarcastic coworkers, office gossip, and wild revenge fantasies that are stronger than reality. Things get crazier when CEO Perry announces an office runway competition.

The loser must enter the Black Room. The winner gets extra vacation leave.

The office becomes a fashion battlefield full of team politics and drama that is both funny and painfully real. The season ends with a fake elimination into the Black Room that makes the whole crew almost laugh on set."
